subject: Re: Post-call recap — AcmeHealth private/VPC requirements & next steps
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Li <amanda.li@acmehealth.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap — AcmeHealth private/VPC requirements & next steps

Hi Amanda / Sanjay —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so everyone is aligned and we have clear next steps. Please correct me if I missed anything.

What we heard (pain & constraints)
- Data residency: All PHI-derived artifacts must remain in AcmeHealth-controlled infrastructure in the US (no cross-border egress).
- Air-gap / strict egress rules: Primary environment is effectively air-gapped for model inference; any external connectivity must be pre-approved and limited.
- Networking constraints: Only a small set of outbound IPs/ports can be opened; no inbound access from public internet to the inference nodes.
- Compliance: SOC 2 + HITRUST in roadmap; need KMS integration (customer-managed keys) and audit logs.
- Latency & scale: Real-time inference targets for triage workflows (95th percentile < 250ms) and batch export pipelines for analytics.
- Cost sensitivity & predictability: Procurement needs an initial TCO estimate and options for reserved capacity / on-prem licensing.

Goals you stated
- Proof-of-concept to validate private inference in a VPC-first setup, with an option to run fully air-gapped/on-prem for production.
- Clear network runbook and SOC2 evidence for security/compliance review.
- Timeline: validation within 4–6 weeks, production in 2–3 months depending on procurement.

What Redwood can provide
- Private deployment options (VPC-hosted or on-prem package for air-gapped environments).
- KMS/HSM integration for customer-managed keys and detailed audit logs (we'll share SOC2 summary).
- Engineering pre-engagement to map network flows and propose a hardened architecture.
- Preliminary TCO and reserved-capacity options for predictable pricing.

Attachments included: redwood-private-vpc-arch-diagram.pdf, soc2-summary.pdf, network-requirements-template.xlsx

Proposed next steps
1) Technical deep-dive with your infra/security team — please share 2x 60-min slots next week (we proposed times below).
2) You share peak traffic profile (TPS, avg token/sequence length) and whether the production environment will be fully air-gapped or VPC with limited egress.
3) We'll deliver an initial TCO + deployment checklist and a proposed timeline for POC.

Proposed deep-dive slots (PST):
- Tue Apr 20 — 10:00am or 3:00pm
- Wed Apr 21 — 9:00am or 2:00pm

Thanks — Neha (SE) and Marissa (Solutions) will join the technical call.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachments: redwood-private-vpc-arch-diagram.pdf (diagram), soc2-summary.pdf (summary), network-requirements-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Amanda Li <amanda.li@acmehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmehealth.com>, Jon Mehta <jon.mehta@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 16:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — AcmeHealth private/VPC requirements & next steps

Camila —

Thanks for the thorough recap, that matches our notes. A few clarifications and asks from our side:
- Procurement wants two pricing options: (A) VPC-hosted private deployment with customer-managed keys and (B) fully air-gapped on-prem appliance license; include a high-level TCO and what components differ.
- Compliance is the priority — our security lead Jon Mehta (cc'd) will need the SOC 2 report + network requirements ASAP. If you can share a SOC2 summary and the network ports matrix, that will speed our review.
- Timeline: we'd like a POC run in a staging VPC first. If that looks good, we will evaluate the on-prem appliance procurement.

I'll confirm internal availability for the deep-dive but can tentatively do Tue Apr 20 at 10am. Also, procurement will want an NDA/MOU before we share any sensitive traffic profiles.

Regards,
Amanda Li
Sr. Director, Product & Ops
AcmeHealth
amanda.li@acmehealth.com
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Li <amanda.li@acmehealth.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — AcmeHealth private/VPC requirements & next steps

Amanda — great, thanks for the quick response and for looping Jon in. Confirming next items from Redwood's side:

1) I'll send the SOC2 summary and the network ports matrix by EOD today (attached). The SOC2 summary includes our scope and control map related to inference and data handling.
2) We can provide both pricing tracks (VPC private + on-prem license). We'll include a line-item TCO in the next 48 hours; the on-prem option assumes customer provides rack space and network isolation.
3) We agree on starting with a staging VPC POC. Once we have the NDA in place, please share the traffic profile (peak TPS, avg seq length) so we can run the cost projection and right-size the deployment.

Technical deep-dive: Tue Apr 20 10:00am PST works for us — Neha and Marissa will join. I requested a 60-min slot. I'll send a calendar invite once Amanda confirms.

FYI notes for your infra/security team:
- For air-gapped/on-prem: we typically ship an appliance bundle and an operations runbook. We will need a window for a network mirror port or discrete data transfer procedure to seed models and weights.
- For VPC-private: we use a small, allow-listed set of outbound endpoints for updates and telemetry; if you cannot open any egress, we can implement a controlled data diode procedure but that extends delivery by ~2 weeks.

Next steps (action owners):
- Camila: send SOC2 summary + network matrix (today) — DONE (attached).
- AcmeHealth: execute NDA/MOU and share traffic profile (Amanda / Jon).
- Redwood (Neha): join technical deep-dive and capture detailed port/IP requirements.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com

--

Subject: Re: Post-call recap — AcmeHealth private/VPC requirements & next steps

Hi Amanda / Sanjay —

I'll be the SE on the deep-dive and will prepare the technical checklist. A couple of asks to speed the call:
- Can you share the network diagram for the target environment (even a whiteboard export is fine)?
- Do you have a list of approved CAs and any internal proxy TLS interception we should know about?
- Please fill the network-requirements-template.xlsx with your allowed outbound IP ranges (if any) and expected throughput (connections/sec and peak concurrent requests).

I will bring our private deployment runbook and a sample set of firewall rules to the call. If you prefer, I can also include a short checklist for air-gap model seeding and an outline of time/cost impacts for no-egress installations.

See you on Tue 4/20 10:00am PST; I'll send an agenda and pre-read today.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com
